name: Group Webform
description: Group relation plugin (Group 3.x) that lets webform submissions be posted into and access-controlled by Groups.
project_description:
This module is designed to associate group specific webforms with a group when using the Group module.

 Requirements

 Group module ( http://drupal.org/project/group ).

 Webform module. ( http://drupal.org/project/webform ).

 Drupal 8

 The Drupal 8 version of this module needs the patch from [#2797793]. This is needed since Group content for the Groups module was originally meant to support only content entities. Since webform's are config entities, the patch is needed to support this.
